run.command: yardr group set planners model=claude-opus-5-5 effort=low
run.description: Change some settings of a group and keep the rest
does: changes the group planners on the herdr runner: what each of its sessions runs, as the lines below say, and nothing else of it.
Each session starts with the model claude-opus-4 now.
Each session will start with the model claude-opus-5-5.
It sets no effort now, so each session starts at its harness's own.
Each session will start at the effort low: "--effort" "low" are added after its other flags.
run.back: yardr group set planners model=claude-opus-4 --unset effort

weight.line: brings a program the yard will run: its model of the group planners, which each session the yard starts for it then runs as the card shows
